symptoms: Severe / Life Threatening: HR > 120 or bradycardia, SpO2 < 90%, PaO2 < 60 mmHg, PaCO2 > 42 mmHg, Peak Flow < 50% or unable to perform.
Moderate: HR 100-120, SpO2 90-95%, PaCO2 < 42 mmHg, PEFR 50-75%.

management_steps.details: MgSO4 25-50mg/kg (adults 2g) IVI over 15 mins. Salbutamol 4ug/kg (adults 250ug) IVI slowly. B2 Agonist (Salbutamol/Fenoterol) AND Anticholinergic (Ipratropium bromide) MDI + spacer or continuous nebulization. In extremis: Adrenaline 0.3mg IMI OR Adrenaline infusion 0.05ug/kg/min IV.
Hydrocortisone 5mg/kg (adults 200mg) IVI stat + MDI + spacer or continuous nebulization.

MDI Adults: Salbutamol 100ug 2 puffs, Ipratropium 20ug 1-4 puffs. MDI Paeds: Salbutamol 100ug 2 puffs, Ipratropium 20ug (<5 yrs 2 puffs, 5-12 yrs 4 puffs). Nebs Adults: Salbutamol 2.5-5mg, Ipratropium 500ug. Nebs Paeds: Salbutamol (20m-5 yrs 2.5mg, 6-12 yrs 2.5-5mg), Ipratropium (<5 yrs 250ug, 5-12 yrs 250-500ug).

Ventilator settings: SIMV mode, TV 6-8 ml/kg, I:E 1:3, RR 10-12 bpm (child 20bpm). Discharge Plan: B2 agonist MDI QID PRN + Budesonide 400ug BD + Oral prednisone 0.5mg/kg po daily x 7 days OR Dexamethasone 10mg IM STAT.

warnings: High Risk Features for Death: previous near fatal exacerbation/intubation/ICU, >2 canisters SABA in last month, recent steroids, ED visit/admission in last month (>2 admissions/yr, >3 ED visits/yr), illicit drug use, psychiatric history, cardiac/lung comorbidities.
Routine prescription of antibiotics is not indicated unless a bacterial source is found.
